title: Let's Clean Up With Pip, Lulu, and Bo
yt_description:
This cheerful song teaches toddlers how fun and easy it is to help clean up toys together. Kids learn teamwork, tidying skills, and enjoy singing along with Pip, Lulu, and Bo.

🎵 Let's Clean Up With Pip, Lulu, and Bo

Hello friends, let's sing and play
Pip, Lulu, Bo start the day

Toys are here, toys are there
Let's pick up with love and care

Clean up, clean up, put toys away
Happy friends work and play

Boxes full, shelves neat and bright
Helping makes the day just right

Clean up done, what fun we had
Thanks for helping, feel so glad

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
